description: This file defines a custom exception class 'NotFiniteNumberException' that extends 'MathIllegalNumberException'. It is thrown when a number is neither finite nor NaN, indicating invalid numerical input.

classes.name: NotFiniteNumberException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a number is not finite (i.e., NaN or Infinity). It extends MathIllegalNumberException and provides constructors to specify the erroneous value and optional context.

methods.description: Constructor accepting a Number that is not finite and optional arguments, using a localized format message.
